hero.title:
We build the products and
run the traffic.
hero.subtitle: Advibe runs three things end to end: our own sweepstakes platform, a licensed casino in South Africa, and the affiliate desk that drives traffic to both. No clients in between. We own what we build.

sweepstakes.description: Our own sweepstakes platform, built and operated end to end — entries, prizes and player flow running on infrastructure we control.

casino.title: Licensed casino, South Africa

affiliate.title: Affiliate marketing desk

whyUs.heading: Built for people who move fast and own the outcome.

ai.title: AI in the actual workflow
ai.description: Engineers ship with Copilot, Cursor and Claude Code. Designers work AI-assisted in Figma. It's not a policy on paper — it's how the work gets done day to day.

decisions.title: Short decision loops
decisions.description: No layers between an idea and shipping it. Small teams own their part of the platform or the desk end to end.

ownership.title: We own what we ship
ownership.description: Every product and every offer is ours. No client approvals, no second-guessing someone else's roadmap.

testimonials.heading: Client Testimonials
testimonials.description: What the companies we work with have to say.

hrDirector.quote: The Advibe team quickly grasped not only the formal requirements for the position, but also what kind of person would truly be a good fit for our team. Instead of a flood of resumes, we received a few carefully selected candidates, each of whom met our expectations.

founder.quote: We needed to fill several positions simultaneously without compromising the quality of the selection process. Advibe established a clear process, provided regular updates on the search, and helped us make decisions faster. The Advibe team worked as an extension of our in-house HR department.

headOfPeople.quote: For this niche position, market understanding and confidentiality were particularly important. The recruiter had a strong grasp of the specifics of iGaming and presented only those candidates who truly matched the level and responsibilities of the role.

coo.quote: Communication was transparent at every stage—from refining the job profile to the employee’s onboarding. After the hire, the Advibe team stayed in touch and continued to support the process. For us, this was a key difference from the standard agency approach.

careers.heading: Open roles
careers.description: We're growing across all three lines — sweepstakes, casino and affiliate — hands-on AI-assisted workflow.
careers.pageDescription: Open roles across sweepstakes, casino and affiliate. Hands-on teams, AI-assisted workflow, full ownership of what you ship.

howWeHire.heading: A clear process with fast feedback.

apply.title: Apply on Telegram
apply.description: Send us a message with the role you're interested in. No long forms — just a short intro and your background.

intro.title: Intro call
intro.description: A 30-minute conversation with someone from the team. We talk about the role, how we work, and what you're looking for.

task.title: Role-specific step
task.description: Engineers, designers and media buyers each get a practical task close to real work — not whiteboard puzzles.

offer.title: Offer and onboarding
offer.description: If it's a fit on both sides, we move quickly. You'll join a small team with a clear scope from day one.

lifeAtAdvibe.heading: What it's like to work here.

teams.title: Small teams, clear scope
teams.description: You won't get lost in a big org chart. Teams are compact, roles are defined, and everyone knows what they own.

ai.title: AI in daily work
ai.description: Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code and AI-assisted Figma are part of how we ship — not a slide in an onboarding deck.

ownership.title: Real ownership
ownership.description: We build our own products, not client projects. You see the impact of your work on live platforms and campaigns.

about.heading: We build and run our own products.
about.intro: Advibe is a Warsaw-based holding that owns what it ships — a sweepstakes platform, a licensed casino in South Africa, and the affiliate desk that drives traffic to both. No agency clients, no white-labels.

story.heading: A product company, not a services shop.
story.paragraph1: Since 2020 we've been building and operating our own iGaming and sweepstakes products end to end. Engineering, design, acquisition and operations sit under one roof — with small teams that own their slice of the stack.
story.paragraph2: We don't pitch decks to clients or ship someone else's roadmap. Every product, every offer and every campaign is ours. That keeps decision loops short and accountability clear.

sweepstakes.description: Our own platform for entries, prizes and player flow — built and operated on infrastructure we control.

affiliate.title: Affiliate marketing desk
affiliate.description: In-house acquisition for our own products — full ownership of the funnel from click to LTV.

presence.heading: Warsaw HQ, teams across Europe.
presence.text: Headquartered in Warsaw with engineering in Prague and media buyers across Poland and remote. We hire people who move fast, work AI-assisted, and want ownership over what they ship.

backend-developer.title: Backend developer
backend-developer.preview: Our main product is a sweepstakes casino platform, which needs a robust, scalable backend for high traffic and a smooth user experience. Strong API and database skills required.

ui-ux-designer.title: UI/UX designer
ui-ux-designer.preview: New screens from scratch and ongoing improvements to existing UX. Working AI-assisted in Figma isn't optional — it's how the team designs day to day.
ui-ux-designer.meta: Middle · Figma + AI tools · Prague office

qa-manual.title: QA Manual
qa-manual.preview: Regression testing across the platform, plus hands-on testing of new features as they ship. No automation shortcuts — every release gets checked by hand.

media-buyer-facebook.title: Media buyer, Facebook
media-buyer-facebook.preview: Launch and scale campaigns from scratch using PVA. We're looking for someone who's run a vertical solo for at least 6 months — full ownership from setup to scale.

media-buyer-tiktok.title: Media buyer, TikTok
media-buyer-tiktok.preview: Launch and scale TikTok campaigns from scratch using PVA. Same bar as our other desks — solo experience running a vertical for 6+ months.

media-buyer-twitter.title: Media buyer, Twitter
media-buyer-twitter.preview: Launch and scale X/Twitter campaigns from scratch using PVA. You've run a vertical solo for 6+ months and know how to build a campaign without a head start.

media-buyer-igaming.title: Media buyer, iGaming
media-buyer-igaming.preview: Run traffic on our own offers and verticals in iGaming — no client mandates, full ownership of the funnel from click to LTV.
